strings.신경 써주신 덕분에 루맨하고 타르타로스를 오가며 열심히 일할 수 있었어요: Thanks to your help, I've been working hard, traveling between Lumen and Tartarus.
strings.멜빅 씨하고 많이 이야기할 수 있게 도와주시고, 베이넌에게 부탁해서 메리: You helped me talk more with Melvic, and asked Beinan to arrange a meeting with Merimel halfway through Adrika...
And you've earned so much of Medea's trust.
strings.(그러고 보니 칼리 족은 신뢰에 대한 이야기를 많이 했지.): (Come to think of it, the Kali people talked a lot about trust.)
Oh, Medea asked me to give you her regards.
strings.메디아 님께서도 제가 궁금하시구나. 네, 저도 잘 있으니 걱정하지 마시라: So she's been wondering about me too. Please tell her I'm well, and she needn't worry.
Someday, when I have my own trading company and shop, I'll invite you.
strings.(노엘이 주머니에서 뭔가 꺼내 %s에게 쥐어준다.): (Noel takes something from a pocket and places it in %s's hand.)
strings.우연히 구한 물건인데, 특별히 드리는 거예요! 쥬드 왕국 암시장에서 굴러: Something I happened to find. A special gift for you! I picked it up in the Kingdom of Jude's black market.
strings.도장이네요. 어, 아무것도 새겨져 있지 않네요?: A stamp. Huh? There's nothing engraved on it.
strings.네, 고서적을 찾아보니까 정령의 신뢰를 받은 사람이 착한 일을 하면 정령: Yes. An old book said that when someone trusted by the spirits does good deeds, they can use it with a spirit's help.
strings.아무것도 아니에요. 하여튼, 그래서 아는 정령이 많은 모험가님께 드릴게요: Nothing. Anyway, you know so many spirits, so I want you to have it. You're my VIP!
strings.(평범해 보이는 도장에서 알 수 없는 기운이 느껴진다.): (An unknown energy emanates from the ordinary-looking stamp.)
If I meet a spirit on the way, I'll ask about it.
Not just acquaintances, but spirit acquaintances... Amazing.
I have business in another village, so I'll be going.
Gerda. There's someone I need to meet in the Deborah Snowfields.
strings.와, 게르다!! 제가 태어나서 눈을 본 적이 없어요. 그래서 꼭 한 번: Wow, Gerda! I've never seen snow in my life. I've always wanted to visit. I hear it's wonderful.
strings.지금은 아니지만, 나중에라도, 혼자서 다녀도 위험하지 않는 그런 시기가: Not now, but someday, when it's safe to travel alone, I'll go!
You seem busy. Don't let me keep you.
strings.(그럼 티티가 있는 데보라 설원으로 가자….): (Then let's head to Titi in the Deborah Snowfields...)
strings.(노엘이 %s의 모습이 사라질 때까지 멍하니 지켜본다.): (Noel watches absentmindedly until %s disappears from sight.)
strings.저 도장, 그냥 우연이겠지? 정령이 나 몰래 와서 사용한 건 아닐테고…: That stamp... It must be a coincidence, right? Surely a spirit didn't secretly come and use it...
Adventurer, watch your step... is what I wanted to say, but you've fallen in again.
strings.실례지만, 여기 오시는 동안 몇 번 빠지신 건가요?: If you don't mind my asking, how many times have you fallen on the way here?
strings.히히, 저는 지금까지 만 번이 넘을 걸요. 지금이야 괜찮지만, 처음 여기: Hehe. I've fallen more than ten thousand times by now. I'm fine these days, but when I first arrived, it happened dozens of times a day.
strings.360년…? 아, 그러고 보니 칼리 마을이 원래 아드리카에 있던 게 아니: 360 years...? Oh, right. You said the Kali village wasn't originally in Adrika.
strings.그건 그렇고, %s 님께서 저번에 게르다에 나쁜 일을 막아주셨다고 들었어: Anyway, %s, I heard you stopped something terrible from happening in Gerda. Thank you again.
Medea asked me to tell you she's doing well.
strings.에, 메디아가? 한 번도 그런 적 없던 애가요?: Huh? Medea? She's never done that before!
strings.(메디아 님에게 아이…라고 표현했던 사람은 없던 것 같은데, 아…. 그: (I don't think anyone else has spoken of Medea as a child... Oh, that witch did.)
strings.와, 세상에 메디아가 자기가 잘 있다고 안부를 물어봐달라고 했다니 믿어지: Goodness. Medea asked you to give me her regards and say she's well? I can hardly believe it.
Yes. Medea, being so kind... I suppose time really does change people.
When that person disappeared... What was their name again? I...
strings.…기억이 잘 나지 않아요. 이상하다, 메디아 이름을 잊지 않고 있는데,: ...I can't remember. Strange. I haven't forgotten Medea's name, yet I can't recall that person's...
strings.네, 어디 아프거나 그런 건 아니니까요? 배고파서 그런가? 가끔 빙달한테: Yes. I'm not ill or anything. Maybe I'm hungry? Sometimes being chased by Ice Otters leaves me a little dazed.
strings.그럴 때면 갈렛이 해주는 음식을 먹으면 되는데…. 아, 역시 빙달 때문인: When that happens, Galette's food usually fixes it... Oh, maybe it is the Ice Otters?
strings.나중에 이오 누나가 절 데리고 칼리에 간다고 했으니까 그때 메디아를 만나: Io said she'd take me to Kali sometime, so I'll see Medea then. Once she decided to hide the village, even I, a Kali, couldn't find it.
strings.그나저나 칼리 사람 중에 이제 날 기억하는 사람이 메디아 말고 또 있을까: I wonder if anyone in Kali besides Medea still remembers me...
strings.이런 건 신경 쓰지 마세요. 모험가님, 여기 계속 있으실 건 아닌 것 같: Don't worry about that. Adventurer, I don't suppose you're staying here...
I need to ask Narin something in the village.
strings.그러시구나. 가는 길 조심하세요. 모험가님이 다른 분들보다 또 빠지시는: I see. Take care on the way. You do seem to fall more often than most...
strings.봐, 저기 또 미끄러져 내려가시네…. 그런데 모험가님 주머니에서 계속 빛: See? Slipping down again... But what was that glow in the adventurer's pocket? A jewel?
Oh, %s. Why have you come alone? Where is Io...?
strings.이오는 아드키나 님 만나러 간다고 했어요. 저는 칼리 마을에서 티티에게: She said she was going to see Atkina. I came to pass on someone's regards from Kali Village to Titi...
I see. But if you have come to me, there must be something else.
Yes. A Kali merchant named Noel gave me this. Apparently, an old book says it's a stamp that someone trusted by the spirits can use, with a spirit's help, after doing good deeds.
It is? I can't really tell... Here, take it.
strings.(도장이 나린의 손에 들어가자마자 나린이 말한 빛이 선명하게 눈에 들어온: (The moment the stamp passes into Narin's hand, the glow becomes clearly visible.)
Oh, that's the light you meant.
strings.흐음, 혹시 이곳에 오시면서 정령을 만나셨사옵니까?: Hmm. Did you meet a spirit on your way here?
No. You're the only spirit I've met, Narin.
Hmm... Is that so? An object like this rarely shines...
strings.그런데 이 도장은 어떻게 쓸 수 있는 거죠?: How do I use the stamp?
strings.제가 한 번 사용해보겠사옵니다. 아…. 제 두루마리에 찍히지 않는 걸 보: I shall try it. Ah... It leaves no mark on my scroll. It must be intended for something else.
strings.아! 착한 일 쿠폰이옵니다! 착한 일 쿠폰!: Ah! Good Deed Coupons! Good Deed Coupons!
strings.이제 생각이 드옵니다! 저와 비슷한 아이들은 오래 전 어린 정령이 일을: Now I remember! Long ago, spirits like me praised young spirits for their work with stamps like these.
strings.예를 들자오면 착한 일 쿠폰에 도장을 열 번 찍으면 선물을 주거나, 견습: For example, ten stamps on a Good Deed Coupon might earn a gift, or promotion from apprentice spirit to full spirit...
But as for using it for humans, as that old book describes, I do not know. Nor where the coupons might be... Ah!
strings.메아리의 샘, 샘에 쿠폰이 잔뜩 떨어져 있던 것 같은 기억이 떠오르옵니다: Echo Spring. I seem to remember many coupons scattered around the spring...
If you retrieve them, I believe they could be of use to you, Adventurer...
It is not urgent. Please take your time.
strings.(처음은 그냥 안부를 묻고 도장을 받은 것뿐인데, 뭔가 쭉 이어지는 기분: (I only meant to pass on some greetings and received a stamp. Now one thing keeps leading to another. I'll go when I'm ready...)
strings.(그건 그렇고 쿠폰에 도장을 찍으면 뭔가 받는 건가?): (Do I get something if the coupon is stamped?)
%s, I never imagined these would actually still be there.
Neither did I. Here are the coupons, Narin...
One of the three appears to have belonged to Liriope.
strings.(나린이 쿠폰을 받아들고 뭔가 느꼈는지 슬픈 표정을 짓는다.): (Narin accepts the coupons and looks saddened, as though sensing something.)
Was repentance from the master she trusted and followed.
strings.(나린이 들고 있던 도장을 들어 리리오페의 것이라던 쿠폰에 찍는다. 그러: (Narin stamps the coupon said to be Liriope's. It slowly turns to droplets, disperses, and vanishes.)
strings.…참 잘했단다. 아이야…. 나중에 새로운 모습으로 만나자꾸나. 에코나 누: ...Well done, child. Let us meet again in a new form someday. As Liriope who lives only for herself, not for Echo or anyone else.
I, Narin, who was your family, will remember you.
strings.하나는 제가 보관하고 있다가 다른 정령들이 가지고 있던 것처럼 만들 것입: I shall keep one and make it like those the other spirits once held. Then I can share them when someone does a good deed, or something good happens.
strings.그리고 다른 하나는 모험가님께 지금 드릴 것이옵니다. 착한 일을 하셨으니: The other is for you now, Adventurer. Please accept it for your good deeds.
I'm not sure I'd call them good deeds...
They are more than enough. Here.
strings.(나린이 쿠폰 한 장에 도장을 가득 찍은 것을 %s에게 건네준다. 그리고: (Narin gives %s a coupon filled with stamps, then slips the other inside the scroll.)
strings.(신기하게도 두루마리 안에 넣었던 쿠폰 한 장이 천천히 빛을 내며 사라진: (Strangely, the coupon placed in the scroll begins to glow and disappears.)
strings.이 쿠폰이 무엇을 줄지는 모르오나 지금 %s 님이 구하고자 하는 것에 도: I do not know what this coupon will grant, but it will help you find what you currently seek, %s.
Since you came to meet someone of the Kali, perhaps something connected to them will appear.
You mentioned Titi and a Kali merchant. I merely guessed.
strings.그러면 신께 소원이라도 빌면 될까요?: Should I make a wish to a god, then?
strings.(나린이 건넨 쿠폰을 두 손에 모은 채로 눈을 감는다.): (I hold Narin's coupon between both hands and close my eyes.)
strings.(마치 이리스가 답을 줄 것 같은 그런….): (As though Iris is about to give me an answer...)
strings.(머릿속에 알 수 없는 형상이 떠오른다.): (An unfamiliar shape appears in my mind.)
strings.(돌덩이? 움직이고 있어…. 골렘? 자아가 있는 것 같은데…. 누군가의: (A rock? It's moving... A golem? It seems self-aware... Is someone commanding it?)
strings.(자신도 모르게 그 형상의 이름이 입 밖으로 튀어나온다.): (The shape's name slips from my mouth before I realize it.)
strings.(나린에게 마도리가 어떤 소녀가 데리고 다니는 마도골렘이라고 설명한다.): (I explain to Narin that Madori is a magic golem who travels with a certain girl.)
It is rare to find a master of a self-aware golem.
Then I'll go see Maduri's... no, Madori's owner.
strings.아, %s 님. 이 도장은 앞으로도 제가 가지고 있어도 되겠사옵니까?: Oh, %s. May I continue to keep this stamp?
strings.물론이죠. 저보단 나린에게 더 필요할 것 같아요. 그래도 노엘이 절 믿고: Of course. You need it more than I do. Still, Noel gave it to me in trust, so I'll explain that I left it with a Spirit King.
strings.그 마두리라고 하는 골렘의 주인께는 정령의 가호가 있을 거라고 말씀해주시: Please tell the owner of that golem, Maduri, that the spirits' blessing is upon them.
I will. I'll be going, Narin.
strings.아, 아니옵니다. 나중에 다시 말씀드리지요. 조금 고민할 필요가 있어서…: Oh, never mind. I shall tell you another time. I need to think a little...
Then I'll go. Thank you, Narin.
No, it is I who thank you. May your journey be peaceful.
